releases.notes:
I am finally back! Heres the new version 1.0.6 **MULTI VERSION:**

**New movement**: Noclip flies through blocks with no collision or gravity and ignores the position corrections the server sends, so the move sticks as soon as you are clear of the wall. Dips a bit every few seconds so the server never counts you as flying (Anti Kick, May work or not depending on server).

**New combat engine**: every assist shares one rotation engine with silent aim and a fight arbiter. Aim assist plus, bow, crossbow, trident, mace and spear, precision shot, shield assist, out of reach and no friend hit all run on it.

**New modules**: auto totem plus (now under Orbiter W.I.P), auto login and bed defender. New commands: .ghostblock for client only blocks, .copy and .copypos to clone items and positions.

**World downloader**: rewritten. Joining a server no longer freezes the client while the world is being saved, the entities end up where the game actually looks for them, and it tells you what it saved and where. The world also comes out as the version of the game you are on, so it opens without the game having to convert it first. If a write fails, it says so instead of letting you think the save worked.

**New versions**: 26.3, 26.2, 26.1.2 and 1.21.11 are all supported, one jar per version inside this release. 26.3 is the one that keeps getting updated, the other three are frozen and only get fixes if something breaks.

**Update notifier**: it now reads the whole release list and only ever offers you the jar built for the Minecraft you are running on. Before it took whichever release was published last, so a player on 1.21.11 could have been handed the 26.3 jar. It sees prereleases now too, which it did not before.

**README**: now in English, Spanish and Chinese, with a language switcher at the top. English is the default.

Rest is a big pass. Enchantment cracker reworked with fewer false steps and the commands fixed, server protect stripped down and the dead utility classes from older versions removed. Mace assist follows the vanilla critical hit rule now, so it no longer claims a critical hit while sprinting, climbing, in water, riding or blind. Out of reach turns back off the reach module it turned on, and only when it was the one that turned it on. Infini reach no longer restores the offhand of the server you were on before. Block spam no longer places blocks in another dimension.

Bugfixes on packet capture, auto find, anti staff, item stealer, auto shop, leave message, plugin scanner, hud text and the mojang api helper. Extra crash guards in the packet decoder, disconnect and client stop paths, so a dying server stops taking the client with it.

Please create an issue if any problem and i will be happy to help.

releases.notes:
# Orbiter 1.0.5 Changelog:

Update notifier plus a long bugfix pass through basically every module.

## Update notifier:

Orbiter now keeps an eye on its own releases. When you join a server or world it checks GitHub and, if there is something newer than the build you are running, you get a small popup with three options: update right away, ignore that version forever, or open the changelog in your browser.

There is also an optional auto-update mode that downloads the new jar, drops it in your mods folder and removes the old one without you having to do **anything**. It restarts clean on your next launch if Windows has the current file locked. Everything lives in Meteor Config → Orbiter: the popup is on by default, auto-install starts off.

## The bugfix pass:

Went through every module and command fixing what was broken. Highlights:

- Crossbow Assist never fired a single shot. It does now.
- Saved Item Stealer presets would not load at all.
- Restock clicked the wrong slots and never really restocked anything.
- Ping Spoof could randomly get you timed out instead of hiding your ping.
- Message Formatter with repeat above 1 spammed forever.
- Auto Find flagged every chunk as a base because it counted bedrock as a bed.
- Anti Staff quit the server over names like "developer" or over NPCs.
- Bossbar Flash could get you kicked mid-flash with a protocol error.
- Camera 360 spun like crazy whenever pitch crossed 180.
- Block Spam rain crashed on some targets. World Edit crashed when chunks unloaded mid operation.
- Ench Cracker passive mode works again and `.encc` stops erroring before the seed locks.
- Actions triggers fire once per condition instead of every tick, and `repeat:` can no longer freeze the game.
- Death Override no longer stays engaged after switching servers.
- Smaller stuff everywhere: stuck keys in Spear and Shield Assist, fake health killing you client side, kits that did not fit their shulker, HUD clock off by six hours, World Edit undo eating memory on huge selections, and plenty more.

Also cleaned up state that used to leak between servers and removed some dead code left behind along the way.

I´m open to feedback! please tell me if there are any new bugs.

releases.notes:
**New module: Enchantment Cracker (Survival)**
Cracks the hidden enchantment seed from the table offers, then does everything by itself: puts your item in, loads lapis, burns rolls when needed, re-cracks after every enchant and clicks exactly when your enchant shows up. Predicts all three rows exactly, not just the hint glyph.

> Command: .encc get sharpness 4 (also .enchantmentcracker / .enchantcracked)

**New module: Death Override (Creative)**
  Hides the death screen and keeps you playing after getting killed an amount of times in a certain time

**Fixes and changes:*
- Spam modules no longer get kicked for illegal characters
- Big lag drop on huge command batches
- version bumped to 1.0.2 (1.0.1 was testing new features)
- NBT Lectern Crasher (Unstable,And useless)
- W.I.P Modules ADDED
- General Bug fixes for the **Creative** modules.
